versions.name: Maester
versions.text: Steps 1 square any way. It swaps with an adjacent friend, or with its own king at any distance when both are on the first rank.
versions.notes: maesterSwapAny (3.12 pawns) measured free but not adopted. Other maester buffs (step 2, swap enemy) are lab only.

versions.name: Beast
versions.text: Steps 1 square any way, takes on any adjacent square, and can keep taking in the same turn (never a king as a follow-up).
versions.notes: Any-direction step (2026-09-13) and no blind spot (2026-09-17; 4.34 pawns). Diagonal readings halve its value (lab only). One beast per army (2026-10-04).

versions.name: Ogre
versions.text: Steps 1 square any way. It takes an adjacent enemy (not a guard), or pushes an adjacent non-king piece one square straight and follows it.
versions.notes: Took the paladin's place in the pool (2026-09-24). ogreMode=push is the default; repel is a lab reading. Value 318.

versions.name: Paladin
versions.text: Moves like a queen, jumps friends, never takes a king, and removes itself after taking anything but a pawn.
versions.notes: Owner 2026-10-09: back in the random pool, approved reading (survives a pawn capture, 2.87 pawns). Being built. White scored about +6 points with it in 2026-09; the rules may be tweaked later. Out of the random pool since 2026-09-24. Still legal in custom setups, FEN and old promotion sets. Kamikaze 'nonPawn' shipped in v0.7.0 (2.87 pawns).

versions.name: Card mode
versions.text: Each side starts with the same four random one-use cards from the deal.
versions.notes: Lab only, not in the playable game. deal-d1: White 50.2% (Δ −0.2 ± 2.4), draws −10.6 ± 1.7. Holds at depth 4. Tested deal = deal-d1's 27 cards + MirrorB. deal-nosalv is done (no card off its interval); deal-nosalv2 and deal-d4k (full size) are running.

versions.name: Freeze
versions.text: One enemy piece cannot move on the opponent's next turn; then you make your move.
versions.notes: +1.15 pawns against no card (cards-d1). In the tested deal.

versions.name: Ice Wall
versions.text: One of your pieces cannot be taken on the opponent's next turn; then you make your move.
versions.notes: +0.55 pawns, at or below the 0.7 floor. In the tested deal.

versions.name: Strike
versions.text: Move one of your pieces (not a pawn) as a queen, to an empty square.
versions.notes: +1.55 pawns. In the tested deal.

versions.name: Haste
versions.text: Move one piece twice in one turn, without taking.
versions.notes: +2.59 pawns. In the tested deal.

versions.name: Flight
versions.text: Move one of your pieces to any empty square in your own half.
versions.notes: About +1.5 pawns. In the tested deal.

versions.name: Sacrifice
versions.text: Swap one of your pawns with one of your captured pieces.
versions.notes: +1.37 pawns. In the tested deal.

versions.name: March
versions.text: Pawns may move two squares forward.
versions.notes: +0.56 pawns, below the 0.7 floor. The owner has not decided whether to keep it.

versions.name: Leap
versions.text: Your pieces may jump over your own pawns.
versions.notes: +0.79 pawns. In the tested deal.

versions.name: Mimic
versions.text: A piece moves to an empty square the way another of your piece types moves.
versions.notes: +1.29 pawns. In the tested deal. deal-d3m: +5.6 on White's score, then +2.7 pooled.

versions.name: Vault
versions.text: A rook, bishop or queen passes over exactly one piece on its line.
versions.notes: +1.45 pawns. In the tested deal.

versions.name: Curse
versions.text: An enemy piece or pawn (not the king) steps one square onto an empty square.
versions.notes: +0.31 pawns, below the floor. In the tested deal. No owner decision on it was found.

versions.name: Sky Lift
versions.text: Two of your pieces of different types swap squares.
versions.notes: About +1.5 pawns. In the tested deal. The owner keeps both Sky Lift and MorphS.

versions.name: Salvation
versions.text: One of your captured pieces (not a pawn or guard) comes back to an empty square of your back rank.
versions.notes: +1.10 pawns alone, but in the deal it helps Black: Δ White −5.7 ± 3.9, draws +3.2 ± 2.5. deal-nosalv (no Salvation) is done: no card off its interval. deal-nosalv2 is running.

versions.name: Rage
versions.text: One piece moves twice, and it may take on either move.
versions.notes: +4.06 pawns (about 1.7 Hastes), the one overpowered card. Out of the normal deal. Card mode has a ticket for its legendary look.

versions.name: Rage
versions.text: Rage, but the second move must take.
versions.notes: +3.97 pawns: not softer.

versions.name: Rage

versions.notes: +4.01 ± 0.51 and +4.47 ± 0.54 pawns. Neither trim helps.

versions.text: Play another card from your hand; that card stays in your hand.
versions.notes: +2.22 pawns. The owner chose it (2026-10-07). In the tested deal (deal-d3m: −1.8 on White's score).

versions.name: Mirror
versions.text: Play the card the opponent played last.
versions.notes: Worth about 0. Dropped by the owner (2026-10-07).

versions.name: Rescue
versions.text: Your Freeze, Ice Wall or Firewall lasts one more turn.
versions.notes: +0.40 pawns, nothing measurable. As worded it can never be played. Dropped (2026-10-07).

versions.name: Firewall
versions.text: None of your pieces can be taken on the opponent's next turn; then you make your move.
versions.notes: +2.21 pawns. In the tested deal.

versions.name: Firewall
versions.text: One of your pieces swaps squares with an adjacent enemy piece (no kings).
versions.notes: +1.07 pawns. In the tested deal.

versions.name: Earth Quake
versions.text: Pieces next to a chosen square (not kings) are pushed one square away.
versions.notes: +0.77 pawns. In the tested deal.

versions.name: Earth Quake
versions.text: Earth Quake, but the square must be next to one of your pieces.
versions.notes: +0.85 pawns. In the tested deal.

versions.name: Burn
versions.text: One of your pieces takes an enemy on d4, e4, d5 or e5 as a queen would.
versions.notes: +1.86 pawns. In the tested deal.

versions.name: Fire Starter
versions.text: One of your pieces takes an enemy on the enemy back rank as a queen would.
versions.notes: +1.08 pawns. In the tested deal.

versions.name: Control
versions.text: One of your pieces moves and takes like a friendly piece next to it.
versions.notes: +2.22 pawns. In the tested deal.

versions.name: Growth
versions.text: As your move, draw the next card from your pile.
versions.notes: +1.53 pawns. In the tested deal.

versions.name: Growth
versions.text: Draw the next card, then make your move.
versions.notes: +1.09 pawns. In the tested deal. It raises draws in the deal (+3.6 ± 2.6); deal-nosalv: −5.4 ± 5.4, at the edge of its interval.

versions.name: Rally
versions.text: One piece moves, then a different piece may move; neither move takes.
versions.notes: +2.90 pawns (rally-r1: +2.60). In the tested deal. Deal effect is unstable: +4.2 (d3mx), −3.6 (nosalv).

versions.notes: +2.3 to +2.65 pawns. The owner chose it for card mode (2026-10-06). In the tested deal.

versions.name: Death Touch
versions.text: The king takes adjacent enemies without moving, and also two squares straight (forward, back, sideways) over an empty square.
versions.notes: Released reading, replaced by T2 (owner 2026-10-09). As released: 55.4% (d3), 57.3% (d4); K18 55.1 ± 2.9. Earlier the owner kept it as it is (2026-10-03). Trims are being judged (rows below). No choice yet.

versions.name: Darkness
versions.text: Pawns may also step diagonally and take only straight ahead; the king may step two squares straight over an empty square.
versions.notes: King step chosen 2026-10-04: 44% → 48%. Lab only: safe step, taking step, pawn armor, D1 shelter.

versions.name: Random back rank (Chess960-style)
versions.text: The back rank is drawn from QOLRRBBNNAAGMMS, with one Paladin in the pool.
versions.notes: Current pool: src/rules/setup.ts POOL. Paladin and Ogre are built.

versions.name: Bishops on opposite colours
versions.text: If both bishops are drawn, they start on opposite colours.

versions.name: One guard per army
versions.text: An army has at most one guard.

versions.name: One beast per army
versions.text: Each army starts with at most one Beast. Morph cannot create a Beast while that side has one. Salvation or Sacrifice may return a captured Beast even if that gives the side a second Beast.
versions.notes: Owner 2026-10-04: no second Beast. Owner 2026-10-09: a second Beast may return through Salvation or Sacrifice.

versions.name: Castling
versions.text: No castling.
versions.notes: The maester–king swap takes its place.

versions.name: En passant
versions.text: No en passant.
versions.notes: Optional in the 2017 rules; off.

versions.name: Promotion set
versions.text: A pawn promotes to Q, R, B or N.
versions.notes: Fairy promotion is null on every metric; lab only.

versions.name: 50-move draw
versions.text: A game is a draw after 100 plies with no capture or pawn move.
versions.notes: A spawn does not reset the clock; a MorphP does.

versions.name: Threefold repetition
versions.text: The third time the same position comes back is a draw.
versions.notes: The key includes the side to move and the spent-Strike state.

versions.name: Insufficient material
versions.text: A position that nobody can win is a draw.
versions.notes: Conservative engine check; a live Strike prevents this draw.

versions.name: Check / checkmate / stalemate
versions.text: As in chess; every piece's capture pattern gives check.
versions.notes: An archer checks through blockers; a paladin never checks.

versions.name: First move
versions.text: White moves first, with no compensation for Black.
versions.notes: Black's double first turn: White 0.533 → 0.472 (overshoots). Rejected 2026-09-14; a lab toggle.

versions.name: Maester swap and king safety
versions.text: A maester–king swap is illegal if the king ends in check.

versions.name: Kings' powers mode
versions.text: Each player may pick one king power before the game; "No power" is the default.
versions.notes: Balanced readings are official (2026-10-02). K18: 10 of 12 inside 50 ± 4.

versions.name: Power use counts
versions.text: Spendable powers keep the rulebook's per-game uses as plain counters (balanced readings change some).
versions.notes: No tokens or action points.

versions.name: Card mode
versions.text: Each side plays the same hand of one-use cards.
versions.notes: Lab only. Next: coins by the king, MorphP, and the legendary look for Rage.

versions.name: Hand size
versions.text: Four starting cards per side.
versions.notes: Owner 2026-10-03: six. Owner 2026-10-08: more cards means fewer draws; the question is closed. Draws at d4: none 29.7%, 2 cards 17.5, 3 15.5, 4 12.6, 6 11.0. Owner 2026-10-09: four starting cards.

versions.name: Deal pool
versions.text: The cards the starting hand is dealt from.
versions.notes: Tested: deal-d1's 27 + MirrorB (Mirror, Rescue, Rage out). Open: March, Salvation (deal-nosalv done; deal-nosalv2 and deal-d4k running), and which cards finally go in.

versions.name: Guard start square
versions.text: The Guard starts next to its king, wherever the king is.
versions.notes: Owner 2026-10-09: approved. Being built. +0.53 to +0.58 pawns over b1.

versions.name: Turn countdown
versions.text: A countdown on each turn.
versions.notes: On branch claude/turn-countdown (83f442f), not merged. Waits for the owner's yes on the screenshots.

versions.name: Arrange mode
versions.text: Players arrange their own back rank.
versions.notes: On branch claude/arrange-mode, not merged. Waits for the owner. Details are not in the docs I read.

versions.name: Piece balance criteria
versions.text: Six criteria for every pool piece (worth, captures, moves, role, moved, draws/balance).
versions.notes: Owner 2026-10-03: adopted. Open: criterion 4 as written or 4b.

versions.name: ?rules=2017 / ?rules=2021 presets
versions.text: URL presets that play the 2017 rulebook or the 2021 archer and beast.
versions.notes: Kings' powers as printed under these presets.
